title: RabCab
role: Built and ran it at STAK Design
context: RabCab automated the engineering department's drafting and CAM work for everything that could be automated. Customers designed cabinetry, trade-show booths, mall kiosks and freestanding units in a web configurator.
delivered: Once sales and estimating approved an order, RabCab carried it through engineering and onto the shop floor automatically
Two parts sharing one back end: the customer-facing site and a full ObjectARX add-in for AutoCAD
Both keep inventory and costs in sync
The add-in automated tedious carpentry operations AutoCAD had no tool for
results: Engineers were left free for complex custom projects
No manual drafting for approved orders
